lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected acute food insecurity classification data on a regular monthly schedule in 2011, categorizing population food security status across different scenarios and projection periods. The data represents post-assessment food insecurity classifications used to monitor humanitarian needs and inform food security interventions.
